_comment: Pinned third-party runtimes downloaded by New-VibeLoopTestPackage.ps1. Every entry is verified by SHA-256 before use; a mismatch fails the build. NuGet-delivered runtimes (CEF via CefSharp, libVLC via VideoLAN.LibVLC.Windows, WebView2 loader, Windows App SDK, .NET) are pinned by the project files instead.

runtimes.name: mpv
runtimes.purpose: Default video, GIF and picture wallpaper player (Constants.AppDefaults) - required.
runtimes.variantNote: Baseline x86-64 build (not the x86-64-v3/AVX2 build) so it runs on VMs without AVX2.
runtimes.license: mpv: GPL-2.0-or-later (LGPL-2.1-or-later when built without GPL parts). This build links FFmpeg and other libraries under GPL/LGPL terms; treat the binary as GPL-3.0-compatible GPL software.
runtimes.removeNote: mpv's optional file-association installer and self-updater scripts are removed: the test package must not contain installers or updaters.
